 San Diego, CA / Storyteller / Oct 22, 2026 /
 Levinson Law Group Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers is proud to announce that two of its personal injury attorneys have been recognized by Best Lawyers for 2027. Senior Partner Gordon R. Levinson was selected for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America  2027, while Personal Injury Attorney Shannean Specht was recognized in Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch in America 2027.
 Levinson Law Group has some of the best personal injury lawyers in San Diego, CA, and has been business since 2007. Both attorneys received recognition for their work in Personal Injury Litigation, highlighting their commitment to representing individuals who have been injured and helping clients navigate the legal process following an accident.
 For Levinson Law Group, these recognitions reflect the firm's continued focus on providing knowledgeable and attentive representation to their clients suffering from personal injuries throughout San Diego and Southern California.
 "Being recognized by our peers is especially meaningful because it reflects the respect of other attorneys who understand the work that goes into representing injured clients," said Gordon Levinson , Senior Partner at Levinson Law Group. "Our focus has always been on providing our clients with knowledgeable, dedicated representation while helping them navigate what can be an incredibly difficult period in their lives." 
 Personal Injury Attorney Gordon R. Levinson: Recognized in The Best Lawyers in America 2027 for work in Personal Injury Litigation - Plaintiffs. 
 Personal Injury Attorney Gordon R. Levinson has been recognized in the 2027 edition of The Best Lawyers in America  for his work in Personal Injury Litigation - Plaintiffs .
 Best Lawyers has recognized attorneys for professional excellence for more than 40 years. Since its founding in 1981, the organization has based its recognitions on a peer-review process designed to reflect the opinions of lawyers familiar with the work and professional standards of their peers.
 "It's an honor to receive this recognition, but I also see it as a reflection of the work our entire team puts into serving our clients," Levinson said. "Personal injury cases can have a significant impact on a person's health, family and future. We take that responsibility seriously, and we work hard to make sure our clients have someone advocating for them throughout the process." 
 Recognition is not based on paid placement or self-nomination, and attorneys are not required to pay a fee to be considered or recognized. Instead, the process relies on feedback from other members of the legal profession.
 To learn more about this award, please visit the official award site: https://www.bestlawyers.com/lawyers/gordon-r-levinson/250539 
 Levinson Law Group Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers Personal Injury Attorney Shannean Specht: Recognized in Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch in America 2027 for work in Personal Injury Litigation - Plaintiffs. 
 The firm's 2027 recognition also extends to Personal Injury Attorney Shannean Specht , who was selected for inclusion in Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch in America for her work in Personal Injury Litigation - Plaintiffs .
 Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch in America recognizes attorneys for professional excellence earlier in their private-practice careers. Like the traditional Best Lawyers recognition, Ones to Watch uses a peer-review methodology to identify attorneys whose work has earned the respect of other members of the legal profession.
 Specht's inclusion alongside Levinson gives the firm two attorneys recognized by Best Lawyers for their work representing plaintiffs in personal injury litigation in 2027.
 "We're extremely proud to see Shannean recognized for the work she does for our clients," Levinson said. "She brings dedication, compassion and careful attention to the people she represents. Seeing members of our team earn recognition at different stages of their careers is meaningful for our entire firm." 
 To learn more about this award, please visit the official award site: https://www.bestlawyers.com/lawyers/shannean-specht/393732 
 Levinson Law Group Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers About Levinson Law Group Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers 
 Levinson Law Group Personal Injury & Car Accident Lawyers represents individuals in San Diego and throughout Southern California in personal injury matters. Led by Senior Partner Gordon R. Levinson, the firm assists clients with legal matters involving car accidents and other personal injury claims, helping injured individuals understand their legal options and pursue compensation following an accident.
